EXPLAIN WITH positive_orders AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(T0.settle_time AS DATE) AS ds,
    T0.store_id,
    T0.org_id,
    COUNT(T0.order_id) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(T0.actual_amount) AS gmv
  FROM `ai_test`.`w56fa4498_dataset_dwd_catering_order_detail_di` T0
  WHERE CAST(T0.settle_time AS DATE) = '20260101'
  GROUP BY CAST(T0.settle_time AS DATE), T0.store_id, T0.org_id
)
SELECT * FROM positive_orders
